entities.name: Juan-José Aguirre Muñoz

entities.summary: Juan José Aguirre Muñoz is a Spanish Catholic bishop. A member of the Comboni Missionaries of the Heart of Jesus, he has served as bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Bangassou in the Central African Republic since 21 December 2000.
